helpStand: s / stand            stand pat (no more cards this round)
targetsNote: Two targets: 7 and 27. **Go over and that side is dead**; closest without going over wins it. Face cards are 0.5, an ace is 1 or 11.
promptDraw: c to take a card / s to stand pat
result.carry: Everyone busted both ways. Pot {{pot}} carries over (carry #{{count}})
result.scoop: {{name}} scooped both sides and takes the whole pot
result.lowEmpty: Low (7): nobody survived — high takes it all
result.highEmpty: High (27): nobody survived — low takes it all
result.win: You took a share of the pot
hintReasonChaseSeven: only the low side is alive and you are short of 7, so draw
hintReasonChaseTwentySeven: you are chasing 27 and still short, so draw
hintReasonExactlySeven: exactly 7 — drawing can only break it
hintReasonExactlyTwentySeven: exactly 27 — drawing can only break it
hintReasonStandPat: standing is safer here; one card could put you over
hintReasonBustBoth: you are over on both sides; drawing costs nothing but gains nothing
